request.prompt:
Deliverable: landscape flat editorial infographic for a Chinese AI engineering article.
Primary request: compare an ordinary LLM / System Two workflow with Jev / System One in one readable diagram.
Composition: warm off-white paper background, two large side-by-side panels with arrows and a shared bottom flow. Left panel is coral and titled "LLM / System Two". Right panel is teal and titled "Jev / System One". Left panel shows a sequential token chain ending in a string output. Right panel shows parallel branches converging into typed decisions. Add a bottom strip reading "人类输入 → 一次前向 → 可执行结果".
Style and medium: flat-tech infographic inspired by polished Chinese technical notes: hand-drawn editorial accents, dark ink outlines, warm paper, coral and teal modules, clean arrows, no 3D, no photorealism.
Text (exact): Allowed readable text only: "System One vs System Two：两种 AI 工作方式", "LLM / System Two", "逐 token 生成", "字符串输出", "需要解析", "Jev / System One", "并行评估", "类型化决策", "概率输出", and "人类输入 → 一次前向 → 可执行结果". Render each exactly once in the specified place. All other labels, cards, code, numbers, and annotations must be blank abstract shapes.
Avoid: extra words, misspellings, duplicated text, generic brain, neon cyberpunk, watermark.
